description_from_the_seller_parsed:
Dell PowerEdge R6515 – Complete Configuration

Service Tag: H6FXZC3

Processor

  • AMD EPYC 7302P

  • 16 Cores / 32 Threads

  • 3.0 GHz base clock

  • 128MB cache

  • 155W TDP

Memory

  • 384GB DDR4 ECC Registered Memory

  • 8 × 32GB RDIMMs (Micron RAM not Dell OEM) - 2933MT

  • 8 × 16GB RDIMMs (Dell OEM RAM) - 2933MT

  • All 16 DIMM slots populated

  • Original Dell configuration was 8 × 16GB / 128GB

  • R6515 platform supports up to 2TB RAM

Storage / Drive Bays

  • 8 × 2.5" hot-swap chassis

  • 2 × 480GB Dell Enterprise SATA SSDs INCLUDED

    • 960GB total raw capacity

    • SATA 6Gbps

    • Read Intensive enterprise SSDs

    • 1 DWPD

    • 2.5" hot-plug

    • Originally configured by Dell as RAID 1

  • 5 additional empty 2.5" Dell drive caddies/sleds included

  • One remaining drive bay does not have a caddy

  • No NVMe drives included

RAID

Installed: Dell PERC H730P Mini

  • 2GB cache

  • Battery-backed cache

  • Hardware RAID

  • Upgrade from the server's original H330

Also Included:

  • Original Dell PERC H330 Mini RAID Controller

  • Included as an additional/spare controller

Networking

Intel XXV710

  • Dual-Port 10/25GbE

  • SFP28

  • PCIe network adapter

  • Original Dell NIC

  • No SFP/SFP28 optics or transceivers included

Additional Mezzanine NIC

  • Dual-Port 10Gb Ethernet

  • Added/upgraded after original purchase

Onboard Networking

  • 2 × 1Gb Ethernet

PCIe Expansion

  • Factory Riser 1

  • Riser 2 added/upgraded

  • Additional PCIe Gen4 x16 expansion support

Remote Management

  • Dell iDRAC9 Enterprise

Power

  • 2 × 550W hot-plug power supplies

  • Redundant 1+1 configuration

Windows Server

  • Windows Server 2019 Datacenter 16-Core OEM

  • Dell factory configuration

  • OEM/COA labeling remains attached to the server

  • License stays with the server

  • Server can be sold with its original Windows Server Datacenter entitlement

Rack Hardware

Included:

  • Dell sliding rail kit

  • Dell Cable Management Arm (CMA)

Additional Parts

Original PERC H330 Mini

  • Included as spare/additional RAID controller

Additional Higher-Performance Dell Fans

  • Several additional higher-performance server fans included

  • Included as bonus/spare parts

  • Mixed/unknown condition

  • Some may work and some may not

  • No guarantee on the additional spare fans

Major Upgrades From Original Dell Configuration

  • RAM: 128GB → 384GB

  • RAID: PERC H330 → PERC H730P 2GB

  • Added dual-port 10Gb mezzanine NIC

  • Added Riser 2 / PCIe Gen4 x16 expansion

  • Original Intel XXV710 dual-port 10/25GbE NIC retained

Included With Sale

  • Dell PowerEdge R6515 1U server

  • AMD EPYC 7302P 16C/32T CPU

  • 384GB DDR4 ECC RDIMM

  • 2 × 480GB Dell Enterprise SATA SSDs

  • 5 additional empty 2.5" drive caddies

  • PERC H730P Mini 2GB RAID controller with battery-backed cache

  • Original PERC H330 Mini RAID controller

  • Intel XXV710 dual-port 10/25GbE SFP28 NIC

  • Dual-port 10Gb mezzanine NIC (IO BRACKET IS MISSING)

  • Dual onboard 1Gb Ethernet

  • Riser 1

  • Added Riser 2

  • iDRAC9 Enterprise

  • 2 × 550W redundant hot-plug PSUs

  • Dell sliding rails

  • Dell Cable Management Arm

  • Windows Server 2019 Datacenter 16-Core OEM/COA

  • Additional higher-performance/spare fans

Not Included

  • NVMe SSDs

  • SFP/SFP28 optics/transceivers

  • Sixth additional empty drive caddy
